data.gender_notes: Atula is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ātulā’, meaning ‘unyielding’ or ‘firm’. In Hindu mythology, Atula is a name for the goddess Durga, representing her unwavering strength and resilience. The name Atula carries the meaning “Unyielding, Firm” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Atula usually hope their child will grow to embody unyielding, firm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes unwavering strength and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Atula belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Unyielding, Firm.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atula total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_sanskrit.name: अतुला
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is unchanging, unyielding, firm, and unshaken. Derived from the root word अतुल् (atula), which means 'unmeasured, unbounded, immense'. In Sanskrit literature, Atula is also a name of a goddess, often depicted as a fierce form of the goddess Durga, who protects her devotees from all dangers and adversities.

in_hindi.name: अतुला

data.cultural_impact: The name Atula holds immense cultural significance in Hinduism, representing the unyielding and resilient nature of the goddess Durga. In various legends and Puranas, Atula is depicted as an epithet of Durga, symbolizing her invincible strength and resolve to protect her devotees from evil. This name underscores the deep reverence and admiration Hindus have for the fortitude and unwavering spirit of their deities.
data.spiritual_significance: For Hindus, the name Atula holds deep spiritual significance as it encapsulates the essence of the goddess Durga's unwavering nature. The name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of inner strength, resilience, and unwavering faith in the face of adversity. The name Atula inspires devotees to embody the qualities of the goddess Durga, enabling them to confront their own challenges with unyielding determination and courage.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Atula signifies 'unwavering' or 'firm'. It represents one's unwavering commitment towards their goals and unyielding spirit in the face of adversity.
